stages: bounded public next-reply adaptation under common DIALOGUE tag

public.selection: Minimum equal-source public validation CE among0/2000/4000/6000/7994 examples; include zero-adaptation baseline. One bounded pass, no validation gradients.
public.style: DIALOGUE training-only tag for both sources; corpus identity not equated with STANDARD/LOCAL.
public.cleaning: Existing mT5-relatedness-filtered CoSEM source plus deterministic pattern/window/length/repetition filtering, whole chat/dialogue separation, exact heldout-pair exclusion, coverage strata and40-example assistant inspection with6 exclusions. Not semantic/human gold.

task.selection: Minimum equal-style validation CE among trained task epochs1+; original targets copied exactly, no synthetic/revised replies.
task.matching: Same original data/optimizer/task order/style prefixes as project-only run; reset optimizer and restore post-adapter-construction RNG state before task phase.

recipe.precision: BF16 frozen base, FP32 reply-only CE

evaluation.project_only_comparator: Existing exact SEA-LION dual-style best epoch1 adapter from355889, no new control training. Generate both styles on new12 and retain its old20 outputs.
evaluation.criteria: Any context-compatible useful reply; STANDARD/LOCAL meaning consistency; natural conversational Singlish and readable English. No intent-label/exact-reference requirement or particle-count reward.
evaluation.scope: New12 assistant-authored structurally related development cases frozen before training outputs; not independent human gold or locked product test. Old20/50 heavily reused. Public adaptation adds data and compute, not an isolated compute-matched causal ablation.
evaluation.stop: No default promotion or further runs automatically after results.

data_limits: Pattern privacy/export checks are not proof of full de-identification. Keep raw/processed public text out of Git and do not quote private examples in user reports.
Filtering is not independent human semantic review; original pair extraction can contain topic shifts/truncated turns. Inspect a small sample before training.
Sources/public validation groups remain separate. No project evaluation or locked test enters public training.

public_manifest.provenance: Original public replies only, no generation/rewrites. DailyDialog punctuation detokenized; CoSEM wording preserved. Input CoSEM clean set was historically selected by mT5 likelihood-relatedness, not human or LLM-chat gold.
public_manifest.grouping: CoSEM original chat IDs hashed; DailyDialog dialogues reconstructed from contiguous original pair export with strict continuity; repeated whole dialogues removed from train if present in validation.
public_manifest.policy: Both sources use training-only DIALOGUE tag, avoiding automatic corpus=style labeling. Two-party visible context required, not a guarantee that entire original CoSEM chats had only two participants. Train response repetition<=3, perchat caps; marker/shortform strata provide coverage, not style gold or model-selection reward.
limitations: Pattern privacy/export checks are not proof of full de-identification. Keep raw/processed public text out of Git and do not quote private examples in user reports.
Filtering is not independent human semantic review; original pair extraction can contain topic shifts/truncated turns. Inspect a small sample before training.
Sources/public validation groups remain separate. No project evaluation or locked test enters public training.

sample_inspection.interpretation: Small qualitative inspection, not certification of the whole dataset or a measured corpus correctness rate. Native wording is retained; only exclusions, no replacement replies.
